annotations.title: Show an HTML page on the TV

description: Show a self-contained HTML page (a dashboard, a chart, a scoreboard, a timer, a visual) full screen on the TV. It runs in a locked-down sandbox: scripts and CSS work, but there is no network access, so inline everything; images may be data: URIs or https:// URLs. Design for 1920x1080, large type, dark background, no scrolling, no input. To change values later without reloading, listen for window "message" events whose data is {type:"teleq:update", data} and call update_html. Returns an id.

duration_s.description: Optional: clear the screen after this many seconds (1-3600). Without it the content stays until replaced or stopped.

html.description: A complete HTML document. Up to 262144 characters.

title.description: Optional title (not drawn; used in the status) (up to 120 characters).

name: show_html
